name: Nauti Dreams Barbados
summary: Nauti Dreams runs private fishing, snorkel and cruising charters from two Bridgetown marinas on three boats of 32, 36 and 40 feet. Every trip is for one group of up to six guests at a flat price for the whole boat. Its captains also fish billfish tournaments around the eastern Caribbean.
standouts: Three private boats, each for up to six guests, with one flat price per boat
Captain Joshua Proverbs set the Junior World Record and Barbados record for yellowfin tuna at sixteen
8th place at the Offshore World Championship, North America
Two departures a day, at 6:30am and 12:30pm

contact.address: The Shallow Draught Marina, Bridgetown, St. Michael (Nauti Dreams); The Careenage, Bridgetown, St. Michael (Nauti by Nature and Feelin Nauti)

trips.title: 3 Hour Inshore
trips.summary: A short private trip to the calmer inshore grounds, 15 to 20 minutes from the dock, trolling and live-baiting for snapper, barracuda, mackerel and jacks. No experience is needed and the water suits families.
highlights: 15 to 20 minute run to the grounds
Calm, family-friendly water
No experience required
Targets barracuda, snapper, mackerel and jacks

highlights: Snorkel over the wrecks off Bridgetown
Captain cooks your catch on board
Locally made banana bread on board
Listed by the operator as its most popular trip

trips.title: Jetski Tours
trips.summary: Guided jet ski runs along the sheltered west coast, run by the same team. Every tour has a guide, a briefing and life jackets, and no experience is needed.

checkNotes: The site is a single-page app: all page text, prices and image paths were read from its own script file (assets/index-BpWr7F00.js) on the same domain, which renders /charters, /fleet, /about, /faq, /contact, /tournaments, /jetski-tours and /fish-guide. The batch list gives the base as Retreat (Highway 1B), St. Lucy / St. Peter, but the site says all boats leave Bridgetown (Shallow Draught Marina and The Careenage) and gives driving directions to the Shallow Draught. The site's fish policy says the catch belongs to the boat and a share is cleaned for guests; it also states a figure for that share, which is left out here. Cancellation: more than 7 days before departure fully refundable; inside 7 days the deposit is non-refundable. The operator also runs Nauti HQ restaurant and sells apparel; neither is built as a trip. Instagram posts embedded on the home page are dated as recent as July 2026, so the business is trading.
